title: LegalEase nationwide record-clearing — execution plan to 100 percent
planScope: This is the integrated production baseline. The reconciliation changes planning and factory infrastructure only: it implements no additional packet, changes no legal-design memo or conclusion, alters no Master Library authority, publishes no edition, acquires no source, and promotes no route.

baselineVerification.method: Every figure below was recomputed after integrating the factory, production plan, acquisition intelligence and Maryland Tranche 2 in that order.

corrected.evidence: data/record-clearing/master-library/track-source-audit.json totals after Maryland integration: tracksCleared 87, tracksBlocked 163
corrected.explanation: 82/168 was the pre-Tranche-1 figure. Tranche 1 closed the guidance-specification gate on five Mississippi tracks and moved the count 82 to 87, which docs/record-clearing/PACKET_IMPLEMENTATION_TRANCHE_1.md records verbatim. The plan is built on 87/163.

definitions.authorityCleared: Tracks cleared by the integrated Master Library track-source audit. This does not imply source pinning, implementation proof, or a final disposition.
definitions.sourcePinned: Tracks with the accepted source-pinning milestone, counted independently of authority clearance. The accepted pre-Maryland count was 31; Maryland adds exactly md_second_chance_shielding through its two tracked source pins.
definitions.implementationProof: Tracks with tracked deterministic implementation, technical, and visual proof. This does not imply counsel adoption or final disposition.
definitions.finalDisposition: Tracks in a terminal production, adopted-guidance, permanent-exclusion, or fully-proved external-blocker state. Implementation alone is not final disposition.

canonicalParentMappingPolicy.implementationSelection: canonical lane match, then greatest matching-track count, then lexical parentJobId
canonicalParentMappingPolicy.reviewSelection: greatest represented implementation-family count, then lexical review parentJobId
canonicalParentMappingPolicy.aggregation: A mechanical jurisdiction child may aggregate tracks represented by multiple canonical family parents; its one parentJobId is the deterministic execution owner. Canonical 250-track representation is verified separately and is not inferred from child bundles.

corpus.composedNote: The 25 composed tracks carry outputStrategy null and outputStrategyDeclared composed, resolving to 55 units: official_pdf_fill 21, process_guidance 20, custom_pleading 9, and 5 units with no resolved strategy. The runtime ReliefTrack type has no unit or composition concept, so all 25 are blocked on a schema that does not exist.
corpus.expectedNewTracksMethod: 246 PART-1 relief-track source slots counted from the 25 retained Edition 1.2 reviews, times the 0.988 slots-to-tracks ratio measured across Batch 1 (117 slots to 110 tracks) and Batch 2 (136 slots to 140 nodes).

theCeiling.statement: All 443 retained Edition 1.2 assets carry generation_allowed = no. Verified directly against 00_GOVERNANCE/MASTER_ASSET_MANIFEST.jsonl: 443 of 443 rows, zero exceptions, across all six asset classes.
theCeiling.consequence: No official-form component in any of the 250 tracks can become resolver-selectable under Edition 1.2, regardless of how much of the backlog is cleared. Pinning a hash converts a blocker into a perfectly-mapped component that is still refused.
theCeiling.proof: 8 components across 5 tracks are already in that state today — GA ga-nonconv-pre2013, MO mo-610-140-conviction, mo-610-140-arrest, mo-610-122-arrest-expungement and mo-art-xiv-marijuana are fully matched with pinned hashes, correct roles and correct language, and are blocked by the flag alone.
theCeiling.requiredAction: Publish a successor edition that flips generation_allowed to yes on the specific assets cleared for release, per asset and never globally, with all four release gates recorded — freshness, legal-output, technical, visual — and then perform a per-track auditable legal-design and renderer promotion in this repository. The immutableEditionRule forecloses editing Edition 1.2.

blockerPartition.note: Every one of the 163 blocked tracks is assigned to its hardest remaining dependency. Mutually exclusive; sums to 163.

resolvableInRepo.meaning: SHA pinning, guidance-specification authoring, component remapping to an already-retained asset, or a bounded legal-design identity split. No external party involved.

needsExternalAcquisitionOrLicensing.meaning: Acquire the binary from the issuer, clear a currentness or provenance gate with the publisher, or resolve a licensing prohibition.

needsNewMasterLibraryEdition.meaning: Reclassify a retained asset's class, role or document identity. Cannot be corrected in this repository by rule.

legalDesignBlockerOnly.meaning: The controlling review retains an undetermined eligibility branch. Not a source question.

blockerPartition.criticalCaveat: Closing all 221 in-repo components produces zero shippable tracks. It moves 138 more components into the fully-matched-but-generation-blocked state, a 17-fold increase in that population. The in-repo work is cheap, safe and parallelizable preparation that only yields product value when paired with the edition promotion.

hardStop.finding: The Kansas Judicial Council publishes its forms for non-commercial use only. This is a licensing prohibition, not an availability gap; Kansas cannot be unblocked by acquisition at any price. The blocker ledger warns that the gate must not be evaded by relabelling the route as a custom pleading.

rendererArchetypes.method: Joined every official component to its retained asset by workflow key and read structural_class, pages and field_count from the edition manifest.
rendererArchetypes.xfaExposure: One live XFA asset in the normalized 26 — MA TC0021, affecting one track (ma-expunge-mj). assertProcessable already refuses XFA and encrypted byte-signatures.
rendererArchetypes.unresolvedContradiction: docs/record-clearing/official-pdf-implementation-gate.md reports CA CR-180/CR-181 as encrypted XFA against the local private corpus, while Edition 1.2 retains them as acroform_pdf with 81 and 58 fields. These are different binaries and the conflict must be settled before IMP-OF-02 starts.

waves.name: Platform foundations and source-clean official families
waves.summary: The platform capabilities and official-form families that inherit the completed Maryland AcroForm proof. IMP-OF-01 is completed at e209f34 and is not pending work.

waves.name: Post-acquisition official, overlay, composed and conversion

waves.name: The 25 newly normalized jurisdictions
waves.summary: About 243 new tracks routed into the same archetype job shapes proved in waves 1 to 3. Exact track IDs are instantiated from the registry after integration.

waves.name: Template-family review and counsel adoption

waves.name: Production promotion

sharedWriteHazards.hazard: The legal-design intake rebuilds seven whole-corpus files from whatever memos are in the intake directory at run time.
sharedWriteHazards.consequence: A pod branch holding only its own memos would regenerate all seven with its jurisdictions plus the existing 26 and silently delete every other pod's tracks. Two pods in parallel each produce a registry correct for itself and destructive to the other.
sharedWriteHazards.rule: Normalization pods commit memos only. Exactly one integration job, NORM-06, runs the intake and the reconciler, with all 51 memos present.

sharedWriteHazards.hazard: The Master Library reconciler rebuilds nine derived records repository-wide.
sharedWriteHazards.rule: One writer. Regeneration order is intake, then reconcile, then intake — the reconciler reads the track registry and the registry build reads the audit.

sharedWriteHazards.hazard: --approve-composed-units replaces the approvals file with that run's batch only.
sharedWriteHazards.rule: Every approval run must pass every batch whose approvals must survive, and the diff must show pre-existing entries byte-identical before commit.

sharedWriteHazards.hazard: supabase/ is a restricted prefix under the restricted-change guard.
sharedWriteHazards.rule: Every new migration needs an acknowledgement in docs/rcap-promotion/inherited-restricted-changes.json with a blob hash matching git rev-parse HEAD:<path>, a reason of at least 40 characters, a reviewedUnder and a non-empty introducedBy.

criticalPath.statement: Maryland engineering is complete and off the critical path. The remaining release graph starts with every authority disposition, joins source pinning into immutable Edition 1.3 and official-source binding, joins template hashing at family review and the promotion contract at counsel adoption, then joins persistence and staging contracts at staging acceptance before production promotion.
chain: all authority reconciliation and final dispositions: retained-identity reconciliation, public downloads, automation-blocked retrieval, direct issuer requests, commercial licenses, local-scope correction, source-identity resolution, not-required reconciliation, and supersession
source pinning for every implementation target
F-02-template-family-hash-infrastructure joins at REV-01 through REV-05 family review
F-03-track-promotion-contract joins at ADOPT-01 through ADOPT-05 counsel adoption
F-04-packet-persistence-infrastructure feeds F-05-staging-environment-definition in parallel with counsel adoption
counsel adoption and F-05 staging contract join at STG-01 and STG-02 staging acceptance
criticalPath.longestUncompressibleSegment: External permission and issuer response are the longest remaining non-compressible dependencies. The Kansas Judicial Council commercial-license exemplar is the hardest gate because source availability cannot substitute for adopted commercial permission and the route may not be relabelled as a custom pleading. Counsel adoption is the second human-only join after implementation proof.

offCriticalPath.statement: 37 percent of the corpus is implementable today using only assets Tranche 1 already built. None of it waits on an edition, an acquisition or a platform change.

commercialPriority.evidenceQuality: Weak and explicitly flagged. hundredPercentDefinition.partitionGate: PROD-04-hundred-percent-partition-audit adds a verifier asserting that the four terminal sets sum to the track count, that their pairwise intersections are empty, that every terminal-D track names exactly one external dependency from the closed set, and that no terminal-D track holds an open internal work item.
hundredPercentDefinition.todayPartition: A = 0, B = 0, C = 7 deferred, D = the remaining 243 — and a large part of that D is internal work misfiled as blocked. Forcing the distinction is the point of the audit.

reviewModel.problem: Counsel review is the scarcest resource and is per-track today. The registry holds 250 tracks rising to about 493.
reviewModel.unit: A template family: the closure of a set of template IDs, the component role and order shape that consumes them, the branch-variant space, the official binaries any official component fills, and the controlling authority the templates were drafted against.
counselReceives: representative packets and every branch variant, with their exact rendered SHA-256
the family's template hashes, official source hashes and mapping hashes
the authority archive, controlling review and addendum hashes
a legal-output recommendation per track: approve as implemented, approve subject to listed correction, or hold
the exception list, classified on the repository's six-value limitation scale
reviewModel.coverageRule: A later track claims coverage by an adopted family only when every template hash, official source hash and mapping hash matches the adopted set, its branch variants are a subset of the adopted set, the authority archive and controlling review hashes match, its exceptions are covered or classify as one of the five non-withholding kinds, and it carries no open release blocker. Any single mismatch produces a delta review job naming exactly which hash moved.
mustBeBuilt: canonicalTemplateHash(templateId): a stable hash of the template object, so an unrelated edit to a shared source file does not invalidate every family in it
mappingSha256 on PacketAssetBinding, so mappingApproved is pinned to the mapping it was approved for rather than being a naked boolean
verify-rcap-template-family-coverage.mjs in npm test, recomputing every claim and failing on drift
reviewModel.precedent: The pattern already exists twice: the restricted-change guard pins an acknowledgement to git rev-parse HEAD:<path>, and the Tranche 1 verifier re-hashes a pinned statute against disk and fails on mismatch.
